source_basis.name: Finnish National Agency for Education — Evolving Language Proficiency Scale
source_basis.note: A1.2 is treated as developing elementary proficiency inside CEFR A1: the learner can sometimes cope with the most common routine situations, still relying heavily on the communication partner, and can understand or produce very short practiced language.

source_basis.name: Council of Europe — CEFR Companion Volume
source_basis.note: The curriculum uses CEFR communicative descriptors as outcome guidance, especially routine transactions, quantities and prices, directions, transport, simple services, and basic health-related exchanges.

design_principles: A1.2 remains an implementation subdivision of CEFR A1, not a separate CEFR level.
Every lesson has a concrete routine communicative outcome rather than a topic-only vocabulary list.
High-frequency vocabulary and curated topic vocabulary remain separate curriculum streams.
Items in high_frequency_targets must already exist in the current source-backed common vocabulary dataset; later vocabulary expansion is handled by a separate gap analysis.
Useful expressions and complete sentence frames are first-class reviewed targets and are never generated by suffix concatenation at runtime.
Grammar and morphology are introduced through explicit reviewed forms in service of routine communication.
Important A1.1 outcomes are deliberately recycled across A1.2 rather than assumed mastered after one stage.
Listening and short reading gain more weight than in A1.1, while productive tasks remain short, controlled, and heavily scaffolded.
Every section ends with a mixed checkpoint and the final checkpoint samples the whole A1.2 path.
stage_outcomes: Cope at times with very common routine communication situations while still relying on a cooperative communication partner.
Use central vocabulary, practiced expressions, politeness formulas, and repair strategies such as asking for repetition or slower speech.
Understand a few words or short practiced sentences in slow speech and short written texts, and identify individual facts.
Describe a few familiar topics with a limited set of expressions and write a few practiced sentences.
Handle basic predictable transactions involving prices, quantities, transport, simple arrangements, weather, health, and requests for help.

lesson_defaults.lexical_target_count_policy: advisory range; each lesson declares and is validated against lexical_target_count

sections.goal_en: Handle a short, predictable purchase or service exchange involving price, quantity, a simple request, payment, and a basic problem.
sections.goal_fa: یک خرید یا تعامل خدماتی کوتاه و قابل‌پیش‌بینی را دربارهٔ قیمت، مقدار، درخواست ساده، پرداخت و یک مشکل پایه انجام دهد.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask the price of a familiar item and understand a simple price answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: قیمت یک کالای آشنا را بپرسد و یک پاسخ ساده دربارهٔ قیمت را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: paljonko as a fixed price question; explicit euro/sentti price phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Ask for and identify the correct price in 4 of 5 familiar-item prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and say common round prices from 20 to 100.
lessons.can_do_fa: قیمت‌های رُند و رایج بین ۲۰ تا ۱۰۰ را بفهمد و بگوید.
grammar_focus: compound tens and sata taught as explicit reviewed number forms

assessment.criterion_en: Recognize or produce 8 of 10 common round numbers used in price prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Make a short polite request for a familiar item or service.
lessons.can_do_fa: برای یک کالا یا خدمت آشنا یک درخواست کوتاه و مودبانه بیان کند.
grammar_focus: haluaisin and saanko as fixed polite request frames; no runtime conditional generation

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce an appropriate polite request in 4 of 5 service situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask for a simple quantity of a familiar food or drink.
lessons.can_do_fa: مقدار ساده‌ای از یک خوراکی یا نوشیدنی آشنا را درخواست کند.
grammar_focus: partitive after quantity expressions only through explicit reviewed phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Match and produce the correct quantity phrase in 4 of 5 supported shopping prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask where a familiar product or service point is and understand a short location answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: بپرسد یک کالای آشنا یا بخش خدماتی کجاست و پاسخ مکانی کوتاه را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: missä + on; location adverbs täällä/siellä/tuolla as complete forms

assessment.criterion_en: Ask for a location and select the correct short location reply in 4 of 5 shop scenarios.

lessons.can_do_en: Say that a familiar item is too big, too small, or suitable.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید یک کالای آشنا بیش از حد بزرگ، کوچک یا مناسب است.
grammar_focus: liian + adjective; fixed shopping question Onko toinen koko?

assessment.criterion_en: Describe the suitability of 4 of 5 pictured items with the reviewed frames.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask to pay by card or cash and understand a short payment reply.
lessons.can_do_fa: درخواست پرداخت با کارت یا نقدی را بیان کند و پاسخ کوتاه مربوط به پرداخت را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: adessive instrument forms kortilla/käteisellä as explicit service phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Complete a short payment exchange with an appropriate method and receipt request.

lessons.can_do_en: State one simple problem with a product or service and ask for help.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک مشکل ساده دربارهٔ کالا یا خدمت را بیان کند و کمک بخواهد.
grammar_focus: simple negation with explicit connegative toimi; predicative problem descriptions

assessment.criterion_en: State the correct basic problem and request help in 4 of 5 supported situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Combine greeting, request, quantity, price, payment, and thanks in a short scripted transaction.
lessons.can_do_fa: سلام، درخواست، مقدار، قیمت، پرداخت و تشکر را در یک گفت‌وگوی کوتاه خرید ترکیب کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only; preserve complete reviewed transaction frames

assessment.criterion_en: Complete two short shopping/service dialogues with at most one hint.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a supported routine shopping or service transaction using the section's core language.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک خرید یا تعامل خدماتی روزمره را با کمک محدود و زبان اصلی این بخش انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: prices, quantities, polite requests, location, payment, simple problems

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed routine-shopping tasks.

sections.goal_en: Ask about places, follow very short directions, use familiar transport, and obtain simple ticket or timetable information.
sections.goal_fa: دربارهٔ مکان‌ها سؤال کند، مسیرهای بسیار کوتاه را دنبال کند، از حمل‌ونقل آشنا استفاده کند و اطلاعات سادهٔ بلیت یا زمان‌بندی بگیرد.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask where a common place in town is and identify it on a simple map.
lessons.can_do_fa: بپرسد یک مکان رایج در شهر کجاست و آن را روی یک نقشهٔ ساده پیدا کند.
grammar_focus: missä + on; selected inessive place forms as explicit reviewed phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Locate and ask for 4 of 5 familiar town places on a simple map.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and use a few very short direction instructions.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند دستور بسیار کوتاه برای مسیر را بفهمد و به کار ببرد.
grammar_focus: imperative direction forms taught as fixed reviewed instructions

assessment.criterion_en: Follow or give the correct one-step direction in 4 of 5 map prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask where someone is going and give a short destination answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: بپرسد کسی به کجا می‌رود و یک پاسخ کوتاه دربارهٔ مقصد بدهد.
grammar_focus: selected illative/allative destination forms stored explicitly; no suffix generation

assessment.criterion_en: Ask and answer a destination question with 4 of 5 reviewed place forms.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask where someone is coming from and give a short source answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: بپرسد کسی از کجا می‌آید و یک پاسخ کوتاه دربارهٔ مبدأ بدهد.
grammar_focus: selected elative/ablative source forms stored explicitly

assessment.criterion_en: Ask and answer a source question with 4 of 5 reviewed place forms.

lessons.can_do_en: Say how you travel using a few familiar transport options.
lessons.can_do_fa: با چند وسیلهٔ آشنا بگوید چگونه رفت‌وآمد می‌کند.
grammar_focus: adessive transport forms bussilla/junalla/taksilla/pyörällä as explicit chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce an appropriate transport phrase in 4 of 5 familiar travel situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask for one or two simple tickets to a familiar destination.
lessons.can_do_fa: برای یک مقصد آشنا یک یا دو بلیت ساده درخواست کند.
grammar_focus: ticket quantities and destination forms taught through complete service expressions

assessment.criterion_en: Request the correct ticket quantity and destination in 4 of 5 supported prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Find a departure time in a simple timetable and understand before/after relationships.
lessons.can_do_fa: زمان حرکت را در یک جدول ساده پیدا کند و رابطهٔ قبل/بعد را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: before/after with explicit time phrases; departure/arrival verbs as reviewed forms

assessment.criterion_en: Extract the correct departure or arrival fact from 4 of 5 simple timetable prompts.

lessons.title_fa: چقدر دور و چقدر طول می‌کشد؟
lessons.can_do_en: Ask a simple question about distance or travel time and understand a short answer.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک سؤال ساده دربارهٔ فاصله یا مدت مسیر بپرسد و پاسخ کوتاه را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: kuinka kauan as a fixed duration question; approximate duration with noin

assessment.criterion_en: Ask or identify the correct simple duration/distance answer in 4 of 5 travel prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Combine place, direction, transport, ticket, and timetable language in a short supported trip sequence.
lessons.can_do_fa: زبان مربوط به مکان، مسیر، وسیلهٔ نقلیه، بلیت و زمان‌بندی را در یک سفر کوتاه و هدایت‌شده ترکیب کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only; preserve explicit location, destination, transport, and timetable forms

assessment.criterion_en: Complete a supported trip plan and two short travel exchanges with at most one hint.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a supported routine travel situation using the section's core language.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک موقعیت روزمرهٔ رفت‌وآمد را با کمک محدود و زبان اصلی این بخش انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: places, directions, source/destination, transport, tickets, timetables, duration

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed routine-travel tasks.

sections.title_en: Daily life, study, work and simple arrangements
sections.title_fa: زندگی روزمره، تحصیل، کار و قرارهای ساده
sections.goal_en: Describe a short routine, say where you study or work, talk about simple interests, and make or change a basic arrangement.
sections.goal_fa: یک برنامهٔ روزانهٔ کوتاه را توصیف کند، محل تحصیل یا کارش را بگوید، دربارهٔ علاقه‌های ساده صحبت کند و یک قرار ساده را تنظیم یا تغییر دهد.

lessons.can_do_en: Describe three or four familiar daily actions in a simple sequence.
lessons.can_do_fa: سه یا چهار کار روزمرهٔ آشنا را در یک توالی ساده بیان کند.
grammar_focus: selected present-tense 1sg forms and sequence with time adverbs; all forms explicit

assessment.criterion_en: Produce a supported three-step daily routine using reviewed time and action frames.

lessons.can_do_en: Say how often a familiar activity happens using common frequency words.
lessons.can_do_fa: با واژه‌های رایج بسامد بگوید یک فعالیت آشنا هر چند وقت یک‌بار انجام می‌شود.
grammar_focus: frequency adverb placement in short reviewed sentences

assessment.criterion_en: Choose or produce the correct frequency expression in 5 of 6 routine prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say in one or two sentences where you study or work.
lessons.can_do_fa: در یک یا دو جمله بگوید کجا درس می‌خواند یا کار می‌کند.
grammar_focus: selected inessive place forms yliopistossa/toimistossa as explicit reviewed forms

assessment.criterion_en: Ask and answer a simple study/work-place question with 4 of 5 supported locations.

lessons.can_do_en: Say what you like to do in your free time using a few practiced expressions.
lessons.can_do_fa: با چند عبارت تمرین‌شده بگوید در اوقات فراغت چه کاری را دوست دارد.
grammar_focus: pitää + elative taught through explicit reviewed complements; simple hobby verbs as complete forms

assessment.criterion_en: State two likes or free-time activities and identify the matching meaning without hints.

lessons.can_do_en: Suggest a simple meeting time and respond yes or no.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک زمان ساده برای دیدار پیشنهاد کند و پاسخ مثبت یا منفی بدهد.
grammar_focus: meeting-arrangement questions stored as complete reviewed frames

assessment.criterion_en: Propose and respond to a meeting time in 4 of 5 short arrangement prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say on which day a simple event or meeting happens.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید یک رویداد یا قرار ساده در چه روزی انجام می‌شود.
grammar_focus: weekday essive forms and fixed ensi/viime viikolla time phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce the correct meeting day in 5 of 6 calendar prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Invite someone to a simple familiar activity and accept or decline.
lessons.can_do_fa: کسی را به یک فعالیت ساده و آشنا دعوت کند و دعوت را بپذیرد یا رد کند.
grammar_focus: invitation questions and destination forms taught as complete social chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Make and respond appropriately to 4 of 5 simple invitation exchanges.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and write a very short practiced message about being late, meeting later, or changing a time.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک پیام بسیار کوتاه و تمرین‌شده دربارهٔ دیر رسیدن، دیدار در زمان بعد یا تغییر زمان را بفهمد و بنویسد.
grammar_focus: short-message formulas; explicit time-change and cancellation phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Extract the key fact from three short messages and write one supported practical message.

lessons.can_do_en: Describe a few routine activities, one interest, and one simple plan in a short practiced text.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند فعالیت روزمره، یک علاقه و یک برنامهٔ ساده را در یک متن کوتاه و تمرین‌شده توصیف کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only; short connected output with familiar time and activity frames

assessment.criterion_en: Understand a short weekly profile and produce four supported sentences about a familiar week.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle a supported exchange about routine, study/work, interests, and a simple arrangement.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک تعامل هدایت‌شده دربارهٔ برنامهٔ روزمره، تحصیل/کار، علاقه‌ها و یک قرار ساده انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: checkpoint: routines, frequency, study/work locations, likes, arrangements, invitations, short messages

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across mixed daily-life and arrangement tasks.

sections.goal_en: Understand and give very simple information about weather and wellbeing, handle a basic pharmacy or appointment exchange, and ask for routine help.
sections.goal_fa: اطلاعات بسیار ساده دربارهٔ آب‌وهوا و حال جسمی را بفهمد و بیان کند، یک تعامل پایه در داروخانه یا برای وقت‌گرفتن انجام دهد و کمک روزمره بخواهد.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand and give one or two very simple statements about today's weather.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک یا دو جملهٔ بسیار ساده دربارهٔ آب‌وهوای امروز را بفهمد و بیان کند.
grammar_focus: impersonal weather expressions and adjective predication taught as complete forms

assessment.criterion_en: Identify or produce the correct basic weather statement in 5 of 6 prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Say what the weather is like in a familiar season and name a suitable basic item of clothing.
lessons.can_do_fa: بگوید در یک فصل آشنا هوا چگونه است و یک لباس پایهٔ مناسب را نام ببرد.
grammar_focus: season time forms talvella/kesällä as explicit chunks; simple clothing need phrase

assessment.criterion_en: Match weather and suitable clothing in 4 of 5 supported seasonal prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Name a few common body parts and identify where a simple problem is located.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند عضو رایج بدن را نام ببرد و محل یک مشکل ساده را مشخص کند.
grammar_focus: body-part forms needed for symptom phrases are stored explicitly and not generated from nominatives

assessment.criterion_en: Identify 4 of 5 common body parts and match a simple symptom location.

lessons.can_do_en: State one or two simple symptoms or say that you feel well or unwell.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک یا دو علامت ساده را بیان کند یا بگوید حالش خوب یا بد است.
grammar_focus: minulla on symptom frames; explicit partitive kuumetta; simple negation en voi hyvin

assessment.criterion_en: Choose and produce the appropriate symptom/wellbeing statement in 4 of 5 supported prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask for simple help at a pharmacy and understand a short familiar reply.
lessons.can_do_fa: در داروخانه کمک ساده بخواهد و یک پاسخ کوتاه و آشنا را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: pharmacy request frames and explicit partitive lääkettä as reviewed phrases

assessment.criterion_en: Complete a basic pharmacy request and identify the correct short reply in 4 of 5 prompts.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask for a simple appointment time and understand a short proposed time.
lessons.can_do_fa: یک وقت ساده درخواست کند و زمان پیشنهادی کوتاه را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: varata ajan and onko aikaa as complete appointment frames; explicit partitive aikaa

assessment.criterion_en: Request and confirm an appointment time in 4 of 5 supported exchanges.

lessons.can_do_en: Ask another person for routine help and say briefly what is wrong.
lessons.can_do_fa: از فرد دیگری کمک روزمره بخواهد و خیلی کوتاه بگوید چه مشکلی دارد.
grammar_focus: help-request frames with tarvita and voida stored explicitly; no productive conjugation required

assessment.criterion_en: Choose or produce an appropriate help request in 4 of 5 routine problem situations.

lessons.can_do_en: Understand a few very short familiar suggestions related to weather or wellbeing.
lessons.can_do_fa: چند توصیهٔ بسیار کوتاه و آشنا دربارهٔ آب‌وهوا یا حال جسمی را بفهمد.
grammar_focus: imperative advice forms taught only as explicit reviewed chunks

assessment.criterion_en: Match the appropriate simple advice to 4 of 5 familiar weather/wellbeing situations.

lessons.title_en: A short health and help exchange
lessons.title_fa: یک گفت‌وگوی کوتاه دربارهٔ سلامت و کمک
lessons.can_do_en: Combine symptom, pharmacy or appointment, and help language in a short supported exchange.
lessons.can_do_fa: زبان مربوط به علامت بیماری، داروخانه یا وقت‌گرفتن و درخواست کمک را در یک گفت‌وگوی کوتاه و هدایت‌شده ترکیب کند.
grammar_focus: recycling only; preserve complete reviewed health and help frames

assessment.criterion_en: Complete two short supported health/help dialogues with at most one hint.

lessons.can_do_en: Handle supported routine A1.2 situations across shopping, travel, daily arrangements, weather, health, and help.
lessons.can_do_fa: موقعیت‌های روزمرهٔ A1.2 را با کمک محدود در حوزه‌های خرید، رفت‌وآمد، قرارهای روزمره، آب‌وهوا، سلامت و کمک انجام دهد.
grammar_focus: final checkpoint: A1.2 routine transactions, directions and transport, short daily-life output, arrangements, weather, health, and help

assessment.criterion_en: Reach at least 80% first-attempt accuracy across a balanced sample of the complete A1.2 path.
